translationRepairs: When the Prince of Jin campaigned against Wang Xingyu, Chengye shuttled among the armies; Li Keyong took a liking to him.
When the Prince of Jin campaigned against Wang Xingyu, Chengye shuttled among the armies; the Prince of Jin took a liking to him.
Focus unit repeats 晉王 for both the campaign and 喜其為人; the idiomatic second clause invents the personal name Li Keyong, which is not in the Chinese. Restoring “the Prince of Jin” matches the source.

Zhuangzong held a banquet in the vault. Wine deep, he made his son Jiji dance for Chengye; when the boy finished, Chengye offered a jeweled belt, silks, and a horse. Zhuangzong pointed at the coin stacks and called to Chengye by Jiji’s pet name: “Hege needs money—give him that whole pile. Why offer belt and horse?”

Zhuangzong held a banquet in the vault. Wine deep, he made his son Jiji dance for Chengye; when the boy finished, Chengye offered a jeweled belt, silks, and a horse. Zhuangzong pointed at the coin stacks and, calling Jiji by his pet name, said to Chengye: “Hege needs money—give him that whole pile. Why offer belt and horse?”

呼繼岌小字以語承業曰 means Zhuangzong used Jiji’s childhood name while speaking to Chengye; the before wording wrongly makes Chengye the one addressed by that pet name. The proposed fix restores the attribution.
